title: Retry responses with a shorter Content-Length body
reference_notes: Issue 6512: Requests are not retried when a response body is shorter than Content-Length.

requirements.description: Detect a response body that ends before Content-Length is satisfied
Retry only when the configured transport policy allows it
Preserve existing response and exception behavior for complete bodies

acceptance_scenarios.given: a retryable response ends before Content-Length
acceptance_scenarios.then: the transport retries according to policy
the response is returned once without an extra retry

constraints: Keep Requests session and adapter APIs backward compatible

title: Respect SERVER_NAME in external URL generation
reference_notes: Issue 5553: Revisit SERVER_NAME impact on routing and external URL generation.

requirements.description: Use SERVER_NAME consistently when building external URLs
Keep request-host routing behavior correct when SERVER_NAME is configured
Cover subdomain and non-subdomain applications

acceptance_scenarios.then: the configured host and scheme are used
the current request host behavior remains unchanged

constraints: Preserve Flask application and test-client APIs

title: Support cross-field request validation rules
reference_notes: Issue 15716: Implement advanced input validation with custom rule engine and cross-field validation support.

requirements.description: Allow endpoint models to express a cross-field validation rule
Return field-addressable validation errors for failed rules
Keep standard Pydantic validation ordering and OpenAPI output

acceptance_scenarios.given: two fields violate a declared relationship
acceptance_scenarios.then: the response identifies the related fields
the endpoint receives the model normally

constraints: Use FastAPI's existing dependency and Pydantic integration points

title: Honor strict mode for URL values
reference_notes: Issue 8244: Strict mode behavior for URL types.

requirements.description: Reject URL inputs that require coercion when strict mode is enabled
Retain accepted URL instances in strict mode
Keep non-strict URL parsing backward compatible

acceptance_scenarios.given: strict mode receives a coercible non-URL value
strict mode receives a URL instance

constraints: Preserve Pydantic URL serialization and schema generation

title: Align Timedelta timestamp behavior for naive values
reference_notes: Issue 50298: Timedelta.timestamp differs unexpectedly from datetime.timestamp for naive values.

requirements.description: Define consistent timestamp semantics for naive Timedelta and datetime values
Preserve timezone-aware timestamp behavior
Add regression coverage for negative and sub-second values

acceptance_scenarios.given: a naive value contains fractional seconds
acceptance_scenarios.then: the result follows the documented conversion rule

constraints: Keep pandas scalar and vectorized datetime APIs compatible

title: Reduce cache thrashing in F-to-C order conversion
reference_notes: Issue 32453: F-to-C order conversion can thrash the L3 cache.

requirements.description: Reduce cache-unfriendly access patterns during F-to-C conversion
Preserve output values, dtype, shape, and order guarantees
Cover contiguous, strided, and large-array conversions

acceptance_scenarios.given: a large Fortran-ordered array is converted
acceptance_scenarios.then: the output is correct without unnecessary extra passes
the view semantics and output values remain correct

constraints: Do not change NumPy's public array conversion contracts

title: Improve owner search handling for blank last names

requirements.description: Treat a blank owner last-name search as an unfiltered owner listing
Preserve case-insensitive matching for non-blank names

acceptance_scenarios.then: all owners are returned without an invalid query

constraints: Preserve existing owner search routes and templates
